name: Appointment Letter Generator
title: Appointment Letter Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Create an appointment letter with designation, joining date, salary, probation, notice period and working hours. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Set out the main terms of a new hire in a clear letter that the employee can sign and return.
intro: An appointment letter records the job, the start date, the salary and the main terms before work begins. It avoids later disagreements about what was promised.
This tool creates a simple sample letter with the usual headings. Employment contracts can need more terms. Everything is made in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to BIZEASE.
how: Enter the employee and the job: designation, department and who they report to.
Enter the joining date, gross monthly salary, probation and notice period.
Add working hours and any extra terms.
Print two copies and have the employee sign one and return it.
example: A letter appoints an Accounts Officer from 1 January 2027 on Rs. 90,000 gross, a 3-month probation, 30 days notice and 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday.
mistakes: Leaving out probation and notice terms.
Promising benefits that are not in company policy.
Using a sample without checking it against your company policy and the law.

faq.q: Is this a full employment contract?
faq.a: No. It is a sample appointment letter covering the common basics. Ask a lawyer to review your standard contract.

faq.q: Does it cover tax and EOBI?
faq.a: It says salary is subject to deductions required by law. It does not calculate any deduction.
Yes. Use the additional terms box.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It is a sample format, not legal advice, and it does not check your employment terms against the law. Have important documents reviewed by a qualified adviser.
